displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads 01 or L1 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: Low pressure cutout: the low pressure switch tripped 3 times within the same thermostat call, so the compressor and outdoor fan are off.
causes: Low refrigerant charge or a restriction
diySteps: Check the thermostat setting and look for anything restricting indoor airflow (the manual says to verify indoor airflow, charge and thermostat setting)
Technician: check the resistance of the low pressure switch; read the pressure on a gauge and replace the switch if the pressure is not low
Technician: if the pressure is low, verify indoor airflow and refrigerant charge, and check voltage wires (involve the electric company if needed)
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: low pressure lockouts involve refrigerant and pressure readings.
